name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static site content, TLS, security headers, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Manages local Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a Git checkout, virtual environment, database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
